title: gitwizz.version-history/v2
description: Released SemVer tags and unreleased release branches with the commits each adds, exported by `gitwizz version-history export`. Contract and semantics: docs/version-history/README.md.

repository.description: origin URL without user, password, query or fragment; null without an origin

target.description: the --target branch the history is about; null without one. Written by gitwizz since --target; optional for older documents

shallow.description: the clone is shallow: commits beyond its boundary are missing

versions.description: unreleased versions first (newest first), then released ones (highest SemVer first)

version.description: tag name without a leading v, or the branch name after the prefix

reference.description: the full ref (refs/tags/..., refs/heads/..., refs/remotes/...), or a --target given as another ref or commit

taggedAt.description: tagger date of an annotated tag; null for lightweight tags and branches

bases.description: the releases this version builds on, highest first; empty for the first release

changes.description: commits none of the bases contain, newest first in topological order

truncated.description: more commits than --limit: changes is incomplete

pullRequests.description: the pull requests completed in this version, newest first. Written by gitwizz since pull request grouping; optional for older documents

title.description: the pull request's title as the merge or squash commit carries it

category.description: from the title's type, else the most significant category of its commits

type.description: the title's Conventional Commits type, lower case; null when the title isn't one

description.description: the title after type(scope)!:, or the whole title

breaking.description: the title or any of its commits is breaking

commits.description: its merge or squash commit and the commits the merge brought in, newest first

reference.description: refs/heads/main, refs/remotes/origin/main when there is no local branch, else the ref as given
a tag, or the release branch before this one on its line

subject.description: the first line of the commit message

type.description: Conventional Commits type, lower case; null when the subject isn't one

description.description: the subject after type(scope)!:, or the whole subject

breaking.description: ! before the colon or a BREAKING CHANGE footer

pullRequest.description: the pull request it came with (#12); null without one. Optional for older documents
